in_marathi.name: Divyank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine, Godlike, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyank is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'divy,' meaning divine, godlike, and radiant. It is a name given to those who are considered to have a divine or godlike presence. In Hindu mythology, there is a god named Divya, who is the god of heaven and the god of light.
